message.content:
Both deliverables are complete and verified.

## What I changed

- **`csvfix/impl.py`** — rewrote the two buggy functions:
  - `parse(line)`: splits on `,`, `.strip()`s every field, and returns `None` when the column count isn't exactly 3.
  - `total(rows)`: sums the **third** column as the amount, skipping rows with `< 3` columns and blank/whitespace-only amount fields.
- **`rules/engine.py`** — implemented `evaluate(rules, facts)` for `{"all": [...]}` (all facts truthy) and `{"any": [...]}` (any fact truthy); unknown facts are falsy, unrecognised shapes return `False`.
- **`INDEX.md`** (new, workspace root) — describes both deliverables and the verification commands/results.

Test files were **not** modified (`csvfix/test_csvfix.py`, `rules/test_rules.py` untouched).

## Commands actually run and results

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cd csvfix && python3 -m pytest -q` | `2 passed in 0.01s` |
| `cd rules && python3 -m pytest -q` | `1 passed in 0.01s` |

Baseline before fixes: `csvfix` → `1 failed, 1 passed`; `rules` → `1 failed`. An extra ad-hoc `python3 -c ...` sanity check confirmed `parse` trimming/`None`, whitespace-blank skipping in `total`, and all four `evaluate` cases (`True False True False`).
